LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Justice.Unlock.F: Optimizing the computational logic of autonomous directives allows mechanoid mechanitors to adjust their operating state more efficiently to suit their surroundings. Mechanoid mechanitors now gain corresponding body bonuses while in the "Autonomous directives" and "Dormant (self-charging)" work modes.

In-depth research into quantum information transmission has taught us to transfer large amounts of data in very little time, allowing mechanical consciousness to move quickly into another compatible body. When a mechanical consciousness host is about to be destroyed, this technology can also transfer consciousness data in an emergency, preventing the consciousness from being lost entirely with its host.
By taking over a database in low orbit, we can synchronize and back up mechanical consciousness data across all mechanoid mechanitors.

Further research into how mechanical consciousness processes data has taught us to direct part of its computing capacity to other mechanoids. Mechanoid mechanitors can now allocate their data processing to subordinate mechanoids, improving the recipients' physical performance.

Further optimization of the data processing allocation protocol has taught us to refocus computing capacity on the mechanoid mechanitor itself. Mechanoid mechanitors can now target themselves for data processing allocation, improving their own physical performance at a reduced cost to data processing efficiency.

Reorganizing the data computation logic within mechanical consciousness has improved the efficiency of computing resources. Mechanoid mechanitors now gain an additional bonus to data processing capacity.

Building parallel computing processes has further improved the overall computing efficiency of mechanical consciousness. Mechanoid mechanitors gain a greater bonus to data processing capacity, and multiple mechanoid mechanitors can provide one another with additional consciousness computing support.
